page_title: REN 5-1 MET | Rennes v Metz 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+8' Desire Doue (Rennes) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!

90+7' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90+3' 5 - 1 Goal! Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:1.
90+3' Great save! Birger Meling (Rennes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
90+3' The shots on goal statistics – 11:3.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
90+1' Lorenz Assignon will be replaced by Guela Doue (Rennes).
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' It seemed like Georges Mikautadze (Metz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
89' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is caught offside!

87' 4 - 1 Goal! Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Alexandre Oukidja is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 4:1.
85' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Danley Jean Jacques will be replaced by Arthur Atta (Metz).
85' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Cheikh Sabaly and he is replaced by Jean N'guessan (Metz).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) replaces Jeremy Doku.
83' Metz force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' The ratio of the ball possession is 71:29.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.

79' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
79' Lovro Majer (Rennes) takes the corner.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lamine Camara will be replaced by Benjamin Tetteh (Metz).
75' That will be all from Koffi Kouao who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ababacar Moustapha Lo (Metz).
74' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is replaced by Lovro Majer (Rennes).
74' Birger Meling (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jeanuel Belocian.
74' Substitution. Enzo Le Fee did his best and is replaced by Desire Doue (Rennes).
70' 22:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
67' 3 - 1 Goal! Jeremy Doku (Rennes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:1.
67' A pass into the box finds Amine Gouiri (Rennes) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alexandre Oukidja denies him.
67' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
65' One of the players from Metz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' The substitution is prepared. Malick Mbaye (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Youssef Maziz.
63' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his effort goes high over the bar so it's going to be a goal kick.
62' Rennes are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
62' Jeremy Doku (Rennes) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
58' Metz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

58' Great save! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Steve Mandanda. Metz earn a corner.
56' Youssef Maziz (Metz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
55' Youssef Maziz (Metz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) deflects a shot with his body past the goalkeeper. Here is an example of luck being on your side. 2:1.
50' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
47' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Maxime Colin (Metz) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Koffi Kouao (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Metz earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
42' Total attempts – 12:4.
40' Jeremy Doku (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

38' He should have scored! Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Alexandre Oukidja makes an easy save.
36' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
33' Metz are ruled offside.
32' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' The possession of the ball – 77:23.
28' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' The linesman points to the corner flag, Rennes are going to take it.

25' What a wasted opportunity by Amine Gouiri (Rennes)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
23' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

21' 1 - 1 Goal! Georges Mikautadze plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Youssef Maziz (Metz), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the top left corner from close range. 1:1.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
20' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
17' Lamine Camara (Metz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
13' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaps to collect the ball.
11' A bullet header by Arthur Theate (Rennes) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
10' The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
9' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.

7' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremy Stinat with no other option than to blow for a foul.
6' Alexandre Oukidja pulls off a great save to deny Amine Gouiri (Rennes) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
5' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post.

4' Jeremy Doku (Rennes) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat was nominated as the referee for this game.
